title: A Survey on the Role of Crowds in Combating Online Misinformation: Annotators, Evaluators, and Creators

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature on how crowd annotators' political ideologies and partisanship influence their evaluation of misinformation, such as assigning negative annotations to counter-partisan tweets and displaying varying agreement levels based on the political leaning of publications.

Surveying existing studies on crowdsourced fact-checking to identify subjective individual biases in evaluating the credibility of news, and examining collaborative labeling and reputation-based systems as mitigation strategies for biased or unfair labeling.
